description: This file implements Blowfish encryption algorithms, including functions for encrypting, decrypting, setting keys, and cipher modes (ECB, CBC, CFB) using OpenSSL EVP interface.

methods.name: BF_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a block of data using Blowfish algorithm.

methods.name: BF_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a block of data using Blowfish algorithm.

methods.name: BF_ecb_encrypt
methods.description: Performs ECB mode encryption/decryption on a block.

methods.name: BF_set_key
methods.description: Initializes the Blowfish key schedule with user-provided key data.

methods.name: bf_init_key
methods.description: Initializes the EVP cipher context with Blowfish key.
